explanation: erdosproblems.com/1013 states h_3(k)≤(1+o(1))k²log k, while this states (2+o(1))k²log k, and the docstring flags the difference. I checked it: from f(n)≥(1-o(1))√(n/log n), setting k² = n/log n gives n≈2k²log k, so 2 is what the cited bounds imply and the page's 1 appears to be an error. A documented, justified deviation from the source wording.
